title: SpaceX Soars 13% After Analyst Upgrade Says AI Spending Could Pay Back in Under a Year

SpaceX (NASDAQ:SPCX) shares jumped roughly 13% Friday after Argus Research turned bullish on the economics of the company's massive artificial intelligence buildout.

Argus analyst Steven Silver upgraded the stock to Buy from Hold with a $160 price target, saying the firm is "encouraged" by the rapid payback on SpaceX's AI investments.

The call echoes CFO Bret Johnsen, who said on Tuesday's earnings call the company is "getting less than a one-year payback" on AI compute spending.

Why The Upgrade Matters

Just two days earlier, investors punished SpaceX after its first earnings report as a public company revealed roughly $18.4 billion of second-quarter capital expenditures, with about $15.8 billion tied to AI infrastructure.

The debate now appears to be shifting from how much SpaceX is spending to how quickly that spending may generate returns.

Wall Street Rethinks The Same Numbers

Argus's rethink isn't based on new company disclosures. The figures underpinning its upgrade were released Tuesday.

SpaceX reported signing $14.1 billion of new cloud contracts in the second quarter, and Johnsen said on the call it signed another $6.7 billion in the opening weeks of the third. The entire company's second-quarter revenue was $7.8 billion.

AI segment revenue jumped 247% year over year to approximately $2.6 billion, driven primarily by the new cloud agreements rather than SpaceX's Grok models. The segment still posted a roughly $1.3 billion operating loss, though adjusted EBITDA turned positive for the first time.

The rally also comes a day after roughly 911.5 million previously locked-up shares became eligible for sale. Despite fears that the additional supply could pressure the stock, SpaceX rose Thursday, with more than 255 million shares changing hands, according to Bloomberg.

Traders Don't Expect Musk To Win The Model Race

Polymarket traders give Elon Musk's xAI just a 3% chance of having the best AI model at year-end, in a market with more than $550,000 in trading volume. Anthropic leads at 68%, ahead of OpenAI at 13% and Google at 8%.

SpaceX's disclosed compute customers include Google and Anthropic, meaning the labs ranked ahead of Grok are also paying SpaceX for computing power.

Prediction markets don't expect Musk to win the AI model race, but SpaceX investors may increasingly be betting that he doesn't have to.

在阿格斯研究公司看好该公司大规模人工智能建设的经济效益后，SpaceX（纳斯达克股票代码：SPCX）股价周五上涨约 13%。

Argus 分析师史蒂文·西尔弗 (Steven Silver) 将该股评级从“持有”上调至“买入”，目标价为 160 美元，他表示 SpaceX 人工智能投资的快速回报让该公司“受到鼓舞”。

这一电话呼应了首席财务官 Bret Johnsen，他在周二的财报电话会议上表示，该公司在人工智能计算支出上“获得的回报不到一年”。

为什么升级很重要

就在两天前，投资者对 SpaceX 作为上市公司的首份收益报告进行了惩罚，该报告披露了第二季度资本支出约 184 亿美元，其中约 158 亿美元与人工智能基础设施相关。

现在的争论似乎已经从 SpaceX 花费了多少转移到支出多快能产生回报。

华尔街重新思考同样的数字

阿格斯的重新思考并非基于公司新披露的信息。 支持其升级的数据于周二公布。

SpaceX 报告称，第二季度签署了 141 亿美元的新云合同，约翰森在电话会议上表示，该公司在第三季度的前几周又签署了 67 亿美元的云合同。 整个公司第二季度营收为78亿美元。

AI 部门的收入同比增长 247%，达到约 26 亿美元，这主要是由新的云协议而非 SpaceX 的 Grok 模型推动的。 尽管调整后的 EBITDA 首次转正，但该部门仍录得约 13 亿美元的运营亏损。

此次反弹也是在大约 9.115 亿股之前锁定的股票获得出售资格后的一天发生的。 据彭博社报道，尽管人们担心额外的供应可能会给股​​价带来压力，但 SpaceX 周四还是上涨，转手数量超过 2.55 亿股。

交易员并不认为马斯克会赢得模特竞赛

Polymarket 交易员认为，在交易量超过 55 万美元的市场中，埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 xAI 在年底拥有最佳 AI 模型的机会只有 3%。 Anthropic 以 68% 的比例领先，领先于 OpenAI 的 13% 和 Google 的 8%。

SpaceX 披露的计算客户包括 Google 和 Anthropic，这意味着排名领先于 Grok 的实验室也在向 SpaceX 支付计算能力费用。

预测市场并不认为马斯克会赢得人工智能模型竞赛，但 SpaceX 的投资者可能越来越多地押注他不必获胜。
